narrative.overview: Roots is a deep-green intelligence workspace. Connected findings and practical proposals expose the records behind them and offer a useful next step. Overview now pairs visible analytics on the left with two dated findings on the right, beneath a greeting and observed daily changes. Conversation follows both columns. People Groups and Opportunities retain narrative beside tightly overlapping initials and evidence. Native disclosures, light text, pale sage actions, self-hosted DM Sans, and restrained dividers keep the interface calm.
keyCharacteristics: 204px sidebar and 1020px Overview: greeting and observed changes, left analytics, right dated findings, then chat; mobile stacks findings, analytics and chat.
Four initial programme rows prioritize open funding, then funded placements and school pathways.
Programme benefit, recipient, status and next step precede detailed requirements and official sources.
Seven catalogue records include Microsoft; no extra standalone employer row.
People and programme clusters use 40px initials in 44px controls with −12px overlap and a matching +N full-members control.
People → Message → Review makes owner-only Telegram sending primary, with unsent SMS/email readiness in a supporting disclosure.

rules.name: Explicit programme fit
rules.body: Programme fit uses explicit education, campus, service requirements, employer and host capacity. Interests do not determine the default rank.

rules.name: Fictional context
rules.body: Demo context includes 12 undergraduates and eight secondary students with 40-hour goals each; the 35 existing profile totals remain unchanged.

rules.name: Campus-specific capacity
rules.body: A fictional two-place host plan does not meet Sacramento State’s three-place requirement. Student connections are not approved fellows.

rules.name: Invitation pool
rules.body: Known volunteer count is an invitation pool, not event turnout or a guaranteed reimbursement.

rules.name: Benefit recipient
rules.body: Separate grants to organizations, participant benefits, funded service capacity and employee-requested donations.

rules.name: Separate source dates
rules.body: Source research on 24 October 2026 is separate from Recheck fit and local journal timestamps. No automatic web research runs.

rules.name: Field provenance
rules.body: Preserve field provenance and saved edits; an explicit clear stays unknown. Label fictional scenario values wherever they support fit.

rules.name: Observed changes
rules.body: Existing records establish the daily baseline. Repeated observations do not create activity; Today and Last 7 days use local calendar boundaries.

rules.name: Owner-only demo delivery
rules.body: All demo sending goes only to the configured owner’s Telegram through the local bridge. Current explicit send intent may authorize scoped saved draft IDs; a draft-only request does not send. Published static pages have no live backend, and real SMS/email drafts remain unsent. Check request result reuses the original request identity; it must not silently create a new send.

dos: Show accessible profile clusters, cohort counts, capacity or required hours and remaining gaps.
Link official rules from Requirements & sources and distinguish open, upcoming, campus-specific and local routes.
Keep school approval, supervision, provider eligibility and participation visibly unresolved.
Preserve Interests, Participation, Age groups, Everyone, saved programmes and illustrative project plans.
Keep Noted/Updated dates visible beneath finding titles and independent review status in the page footnotes.
Retain ordinary-language chat through the dedicated local @roots_community_josh_bot setup without requiring a /roots prefix.
Make Send demo to my Telegram the Review primary action; keep intended recipients and actual delivery destination explicit.
donts: Do not treat fictional ages, study details or service targets as verified real-person facts.
Do not infer eligibility, consent, attendance, employer benefits or financial need from interests or names.
Do not present a statewide allocation, annual policy cap or possible reimbursement as secured income.
Do not describe local recalculation as a new source search or restore generic interest matching as the opportunity ranking.
Do not invent daily history from seeded records or treat owner Telegram demos as volunteer outreach.
Do not imply that a static sample, configuration flag or this documentation proves a live provider connection.
